title: Trip-Charge Credit on Premium Economy Upgrades for Corporate Bookings
content:
**Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — booking-channel credit on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A **trip-charge credit** is taken off the Premium Economy upgrade charge. The trip-charge credit is the credit share of the trip charges, the trip charges being the change, bag and upgrade charges of the ticket.

## The credit share

| Agreement named on the ticket | Lists the ticket's booking channel among its eligible booking channels | Credit share |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | 0.1 (active-agreement share, 10 percent) |
| Under review | Yes | 0.05 (under-review share, 5 percent) |
| Any other ticket | — | 0 |

The agreement's status and its tier's eligible booking channels are read from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements; the booking channel is the one recorded on the ticket.

## How the credit is taken

The trip-charge credit is taken off the Premium Economy upgrade price only after every rate that multiplies that price has acted on it; the result is never below zero, and it is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Agreement status | Channel listed | Trip charges | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | 240.00 | 24.00 |
| Under review | Yes | 240.00 | 12.00 |
| Active | No | 240.00 | 0 |
| Not active, or no agreement named | — | 240.00 | 0 |

*Floor at zero (hypothetical).* A priced upgrade of 20.00 dollars less a credit of 24.00 dollars gives a charge of 0.00.
